name: Confirm Passkey Enrollment
description: Confirms that passkey enrollment completed and lets the user continue from the enrollment flow.

conformance.notes: The Web surface matches the canonical screen identity and complete-enrollment/back finders, but complete-enrollment starts a second authenticated passkey authentication ceremony and does not navigate to application home on success. The canonical passkey-registration flow expects the authenticated session to already exist and complete-enrollment to perform client navigation to app.home.

notes: The prior finish/done ambiguity is replaced by the single semantic action complete-enrollment.
